title: AVOID
description:
New flavours of demise. Free.
Two new Sektors, Suspension Fields, Force Drop, Rewinds, faster speeds, a modifier system, and Optimise mode.

Twist, ΔVØID, die, repeat.ΔVØID is a first-person precision runner where the only way forward is to twist the world around you until gravity works in your favour.

Feel yourself getting better with each 90-degree rotation as you twist and bend your way through 11 visually striking, procedurally generated environments.

Prepare for your delicious demise... 

 Key Features• Rotate the world around you in 90 degree increments. It's wall-running redefined.
 

• Experience unique "Transition Circuits", the boss-like final challenge before advancing each level.
 

• Steadily take on more challenging obstacles and gravity-defying stunts. 

• Combine moves in satisfying and creative ways. 

• Select one of 6 speeds to do it all again, but faster!
 
 

• Choose your modifiers. Make your runs harder and rack up bigger scores.

• Every run, every modifier, one leaderboard. 

• Atmospheric environments you'll want to take a second look at. 
 

• Enjoy a meticulously curated soundtrack to match the fast-paced action. 

• Unlock 80+ achievements.
description_short: Experience the fast-paced thrill of ΔVØID, a first-person endless runner with a head-turning twist: the only way forward is to twist the world around you until gravity works in your favour.
